decisions.reader_note: For MongoDB’s fiscal years ended January 31, 2024, 2025 and 2026, basic and diluted EPS use the same reported denominator because potential shares are anti-dilutive in the loss periods. These are January fiscal-year ends, not December calendar-year ends. The filing also excludes capped calls from diluted-share calculations as anti-dilutive; they are not additional denominator shares. Shares and per-share data are exempt from the thousands-of-dollars heading and use scale-zero tags.

paragraph_requires: As the liquidation and dividend rights are identical, the net loss is allocated on a proportionate basis.
In periods in which we incurred a net loss, all potentially dilutive securities are antidilutive and accordingly, basic net loss per share equals diluted net loss per share.
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Workiva applies the two-class method and allocates net loss proportionately between Class A and Class B shares because their liquidation and dividend rights are identical. The selected statement denominator combines both classes; the separate class denominators in the EPS note should not replace it. Potential stock awards and convertible-note shares are excluded as antidilutive in these loss periods. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the statement’s thousands heading and use scale-zero tags.
